status_summary: HHS published restated Office of General Counsel organization statements on 2025-03-14 and 2026-09-29, each rescinding all prior statements of organization; both describe an OGC division that advises on civil rights and conscience laws and serves as counsel to OCR, without stating that OGC enforces conscience laws. HHS reorganized OCR effective 2026-06-28 with a Conscience and Religious Freedom Division. No rescission of the PREP Act memo, the eviction moratorium analysis or the Bowen analysis was found, and no source read describes a specific delegation of conscience or RFRA enforcement being returned from OGC to OCR.

timeline.event: HHS published a restated OGC organization statement that rescinds all prior statements; it describes a civil rights division advising OCR on conscience statutes (publication date).
HHS Office for Civil Rights reorganization took effect, creating a Conscience and Religious Freedom Division (published 2026-06-30).

HHS published a further restated OGC organization statement that rescinds all prior statements; it describes a division advising on civil rights and conscience laws and legal services to OCR (publication date).

title: Rescind HHS OGC memos on PREP Act, eviction moratorium, newborns and OCR conscience role
uncertainties: The 2025 and 2026 OGC statements were re-read in review; each rescinds all prior statements of organization and describes an advisory role for OGC on conscience laws, but neither mentions RFRA or describes what changed, so whether an earlier statement moved conscience enforcement to OGC and is now superseded cannot be confirmed from these texts. Delegations of authority are separate documents and were not located. The OCR reorganization notice does not mention OGC or RFRA. The 2026 OGC statement mentions the PREP Act only as an area of advice. Internal legal memos on the PREP Act, the eviction moratorium and Bowen are not public, so their withdrawal is not checkable from these sources. Timeline dates for the two OGC notices are Federal Register publication dates. Searches run: OGC PREP Act rescission; Federal Register API on OCR delegations and conscience.
